target_name: Economic Net Worth Against Financial Debt
rationale: A defensible one-factor cross of the archive's best-slope numerator with its best-alpha denominator, but the retained-earnings term will dominate the numerator for most firms, so the result risks being a re-scaled Altman-style RE/debt distress ratio rather than an intangible-restatement signal.

Cumulative five-year operating cash flow will swamp the R&D stock in the numerator, making this largely a rediscovery of the well-documented cash-flow-to-debt coverage/profitability signal with the intangible term as a minor perturbation, which undercuts the stated purpose of isolating the restatement channel.

target_name: Backing Net of Unrealized Goodwill Claims
rationale: This is an additive ensemble of two already-evaluated archive signals that double-penalizes goodwill (subtracted in the first component's numerator and again as a standalone rank) and smuggles in a standalone cash-based profitability rank (oancf/at), so any performance gain will not be attributable to cross-theme content.

Replacing MA(oancf,3) with TS_SUM(oancf,5) inside a rank transform is a cosmetic reparameterization of the archive's existing "Goodwill Claimed Beyond Cash Realized," and the two cash measures will be near-perfectly rank-correlated.

target_name: Knowledge Backing of the Maturity Wall
rationale: This is the fifth denominator permutation in an exhausted family, and the MAX(dlc, che) floor is internally inconsistent with the stated maturity-wall story since for the many cash-rich firms the expression collapses to R&D-stock-over-cash — a burn/liquidity measure, not a rollover measure.

The tie-mass diagnosis (zero numerator for firms with neither R&D nor goodwill) is a genuine and specific construction problem, but the fix is a linear blend with a conventional oancf/lt coverage ratio already used in several archive signals, so attribution of any improvement will be ambiguous.
